description.value:
A massive tangle of interconnected computer cables springs forth from every direction at once. Spaces in the area become difficult terrain for the duration. Each time a creature begins a move action inside the tangle or enters the tangle during a move action, it must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Immobilized] for 1 round. In addition, the cables are so thickly tangled that they provide standard cover to creatures in the area.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Cable Management]
